meta.name: evaluating-llms-harness
meta.description: Evaluates LLMs across 60+ academic benchmarks (MMLU, HumanEval, GSM8K, TruthfulQA, HellaSwag). Use when benchmarking model quality, comparing models, reporting academic results, or tracking training progress. Industry standard used by EleutherAI, HuggingFace, and major labs. Supports HuggingFace, vLLM, APIs.

copy.tagline: 用60+学术基准评测大模型质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用标准基准对比大模型性能
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to benchmark LLM quality using standard academic tests

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以指导你使用 lm-evaluation-harness 工具，在 60 多个学术基准（如 MMLU、GSM8K）上评估大语言模型，并分析结果。
howto.when: 当你需要评估模型质量、比较多个模型、报告学术结果或跟踪训练进度时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 lm-eval 评估 Llama-2-7b 在 MMLU 上的表现。
say.note: Claude 会给出运行命令和结果解读。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you in using the lm-evaluation-harness tool to evaluate large language models on 60+ academic benchmarks (e.g., MMLU, GSM8K) and analyze results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to benchmark model quality, compare models, report academic results, or track training progress.

say_en.text: Help me evaluate Llama-2-7b on MMLU using lm-eval.
say_en.note: Claude will provide the command and result interpretation.

say_en.text: Compare Llama-2-7b and Mistral-7B on GSM8K accuracy.
say_en.note: Claude will show comparison methods and sample output.
